spans.s:
कुयज्विन् कु-यज्विन्, ई, m. (see 1. कु), a
bad sacrificer.

कुयव कु-यव, अस्, आ, अम् (see 1. कु), Ved.
epithet of the demon Śuṣṇa, who was slain by Indra,
‘causing a bad harvest?;’ (अस्), m., N. of another
demon; (अम्), n. a bad harvest.

कुयवाच् कुय-वाच्, क्, m. (कुय = 1. कु),
Ved. speaking ill, abusing; or N. of a demon who
was slain by Indra (?).

कुयोग कु-योग, अस्, m. (see 1. कु), an in-
auspicious conjunction of planets, signs, periods, &c.

कु-योगिन्, ई, m. a false devotee, an impostor, a
hypocrite.

कुयोनि कु-योनि, इस्, f. (see 1. कु), a base
womb, the womb of a low woman.
